unconfirmed: Routine changes are unconfirmed. Refresh to read stored state; save again only when ready.
historyLimit: Up to 100 retained runs per routine. Refresh reads history without starting work.
executionUnknown: Execution is unknown. No automatic replay.
quiet: Stay quiet when there is nothing to report
offsetNote: An explicit UTC offset controls cron matching. It stays fixed across daylight-saving changes. Without an offset, the server uses Paris time and its daylight-saving rules.
timezoneNote: The timezone label is metadata only. It does not convert times or select daylight-saving rules.
pauseNote: Pause prevents future occurrences. It does not cancel an active run. Task cancellation is a separate action in Work.
deliveryNote: Delivery uses saved instructions, not this edited draft. The same delivery ID is claimed once. Event payloads are not consumed. Zero completed runs can mean paused, duplicate, busy or failed; read history for the outcome.
